title: 第158章 教导
slug: 求生游戏请叫我诚信商人
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

希维尔不知道什么时候已经离开了。

前坪除了被拆得四分五裂的各种飞舟部件，就只剩下了李知和西莉亚。

她在西莉亚对面坐下，“我想拉一个兽人商人加入交易所，你怎么看。”

西莉亚：“整个兽盟也没有几个商人，而且全都是3级以下连卖武器装备的资格都没有的商人，你让兽人加入的理由是什么？”

——当然为打入百兽集市和兽盟打下基础顺便拉个盟友。

李知：“交易所的存在，是为了所有种族都可以享受到其他种族的最新发明和公平交易，也是为了帮股东们规避部分风险，这样确实能够赚钱，但基数不够大，整个天启大陆，兽人族才是最大的族群，如果不让兽人族入伙，兽人如何相信并且在我们的交易所交易？”

西莉亚：“兽人能存什么？骨头？肉干？”

李知：“兽人族在科技上确实落后于其他种族，但是她们其实是低端武器和装备最大的购买者，我相信，大部分商人手里都有囤积一部分D级以下的装备和武器，这些武器和装备只能在交易区看情况售卖，如果让兽人族加入进来，这部分武器和装备就能去库存，也是一件好事。”

西莉亚：“我不同意，其他股东也不会同意，你能加入其中，是因为你是发起者，新生种族潜力不高，但是如你所言，基数比兽人族更大，而且评级还没到来，依旧有交好的潜力，但兽人族什么都没有，她们的存在只会拉低交易所的上限。”

“你现在接触到的S级种族只有我，但是我不能代表所有S级种族，甚至一些A级种族，比如羽灵族，就会因为兽人族加入其中而拒绝成为交易所的合伙人。”

“你现在把这个想法告诉我是好事，这样在交易大会那天就不会因为说出这种话，而失去潜在的合伙人和顾客。”

“我曾经告诉过你，商人并不会将种族等级分得太清楚，但是我现在要告诉你，商业早就将不同等级的种族分隔开来。”

“兽人族数量庞大，却连天启大陆1%的财富都无法占据，低等与低劣总是互相映衬，我们要做的，是从拥有99%的财富的种族手里掏钱，让她们掏钱之前，你得先让她们信任你，认为你是自己人。”

西莉亚说话时，神色是变化的。

起初是严肃和不赞同，后来变成了有意的教导，到最后，是一直脚踏红毯的上位者，不小心踩到了黄泥地的嫌恶和庆幸。

庆幸她一直在红毯上，不小心沾在她鞋上的黄泥，只是一桩提起来都有损格调的意外。

李知沉默着。

片刻后，她点点头：“我知道了，这件事我不会再提了，只是我的职业路径要求我要在兽人族进行交易，我想要收购一批低级武器，老师你有办法帮我弄到吗？”

西莉亚愣了下，深深的法令纹也平整了些：“你要多少？”

李知：“有多少要多少。”

西莉亚：“等着。”

Page (1/3)

Sivir didn't know when he had left.

Apart from the various parts of the airship that had been torn apart, only Li Zhi and Celia were left on the front terrace.

She sat down opposite Celia, "I want to recruit an orc merchant to join the exchange. What do you think?"

Celia: "There are only a few merchants in the entire Beast Alliance, and they are all merchants below level 3 who are not even qualified to sell weapons and equipment. What is your reason for letting the orcs join?"

——Of course, this will lay the foundation for breaking into the Beast Market and the Beast Alliance, while also attracting allies.

Li Zhi: "The exchange exists so that all races can enjoy the latest inventions and fair transactions of other races, and also to help shareholders avoid some risks. This can indeed make money, but the base is not large enough. The orcs are the largest ethnic group in the entire Apocalypse Continent. If the orcs are not allowed to join, how can the orcs believe and trade on our exchange?"

Celia: "What can the orcs save? Bones? Dried meat?"

Li Zhi: "The Orcs do lag behind other races in terms of technology, but they are actually the largest purchasers of low-end weapons and equipment. I believe that most merchants have hoarded some equipment and weapons below D level. These weapons and equipment can only be sold in the trading area depending on the situation. If the Orcs join in, these weapons and equipment can be destocked, which is also a good thing."

Celia: "I don't agree, and neither will other shareholders. You can join it because you are the initiator. The potential of the new race is not high, but as you said, the base is larger than the orcs, and the rating has not yet come. There is still potential for good relations, but the orcs have nothing. Their existence will only lower the upper limit of the exchange."

"I am the only S-level race you are exposed to now, but I cannot represent all S-level races. Even some A-level races, such as the Yuling Tribe, will refuse to become partners of the exchange just because the Orcs join them."

"It's a good thing you tell me this idea now so that you won't lose potential partners and customers by saying this on the day of the trade conference."

"I once told you that businessmen do not distinguish racial levels too clearly, but I want to tell you now that business has long separated different levels of races."

"The orcs are huge in number, but they can't even occupy 1% of the wealth in Apocalypse Continent. Inferiority and inferiority always contrast each other. What we have to do is to take money from the race that owns 99% of the wealth. Before letting them pay, you have to make them trust you and think that you are one of their own."

Celia's expression changed as she spoke.

At first it was solemnity and disapproval, but later it turned into intentional teaching, and in the end, it was disgust and joy that the superior who had always stepped on the red carpet accidentally stepped on the yellow clay.

Fortunately, she was always on the red carpet, and the yellow mud that accidentally got on her shoes was just an accident that would be detrimental to her style even if she mentioned it.

Li Zhi was silent.

After a moment, she nodded: "I understand. I won't mention it again. It's just that my career path requires me to trade among the orcs. I want to acquire a batch of low-level weapons. Teacher, can you help me get them?"

Celia was stunned for a moment, and the deep nasolabial folds became smoother: "How much do you want?"

Li Zhi: "As much as you want."

Celia: "Wait."
